vine.command.help:
Available commands:
  - /server [server]            : View current server or switch to another backend
  - /send <player|all> <server> : Send players to another backend (Admin)
  - /list                       : List connected players
  - /glist                      : List players grouped by server
  - /status                     : Show proxy version, uptime and players (Admin)
  - /help [command]             : Show this help or info about a command
  - /vine plugins|reload [name] : List or reload plugins (Admin)
  - /vine config reload         : Reload vine.toml without a restart (Admin)
  - /ban, /unban, /banlist      : Ban or unban players (Admin)
  - /banip, /unbanip            : Ban or unban IP addresses (Admin)
  - /kick <player> [reason]     : Kick a player (Admin)
  - /maintenance <on|off>       : Toggle maintenance mode (Admin)
  - /whitelist <on|off|add|...> : Manage the whitelist (Admin)
vine.command.help.server:
Command /server:
  Usage: /server [server]
  Description: View your current server or switch to another backend server.
vine.command.help.send:
Command /send:
  Usage: /send <player|all> <server>
  Description: Send players to another backend server (Requires vine.command.send / admin).
vine.command.help.list:
Command /list:
  Usage: /list
  Description: List all online players connected to the proxy.
vine.command.help.glist:
Command /glist:
  Usage: /glist
  Description: List online players grouped by backend server.
vine.command.help.ban:
Command /ban:
  Usage: /ban <player> [duration] [reason]
  Description: Ban a player, for example /ban Steve 1d griefing. Without a duration the ban is permanent (Requires vine.command.ban).
vine.command.help.unban:
Command /unban:
  Usage: /unban <player>
  Description: Lift a player's ban (Requires vine.command.ban).
vine.command.help.banip:
Command /banip:
  Usage: /banip <ip|player> [duration] [reason]
  Description: Ban an IP address, or the address a player is on (Requires vine.command.banip).
vine.command.help.unbanip:
Command /unbanip:
  Usage: /unbanip <ip>
  Description: Lift an IP ban (Requires vine.command.banip).
vine.command.help.banlist:
Command /banlist:
  Usage: /banlist
  Description: List banned players and IP addresses (Requires vine.command.ban).
vine.command.help.kick:
Command /kick:
  Usage: /kick <player> [reason]
  Description: Disconnect a player from the proxy (Requires vine.command.kick).
vine.command.help.maintenance:
Command /maintenance:
  Usage: /maintenance <on|off>
  Description: Only players with vine.maintenance.bypass can join while it is on (Requires vine.command.maintenance).
vine.command.help.whitelist:
Command /whitelist:
  Usage: /whitelist <on|off|list|add|remove> [player]
  Description: Manage who may join while the whitelist is on (Requires vine.command.whitelist).
vine.command.help.status:
Command /status:
  Usage: /status
  Description: Show the proxy version, uptime, player count and players per server (Requires vine.command.status / admin).
vine.command.help.help:
Command /help:
  Usage: /help [command]
  Description: Show help information for available proxy commands.
vine.command.help.unknown: Unknown command. Use /help to see all available proxy commands.
